notes: Every figure is the Chief Electoral Officer's as the press reported it. The Chief Electoral Officer's own site could not be reached.
The roll before is the roll of 9 June 2026. The names left off are the forms that could not be accounted for when enumeration ended on 3 August.
Shifted and absent are counted together as shifted, absent or other. The four reasons published add to 16,076 fewer than the names left off, and no source names the rest.
Claims and objections ran to 12 September 2026 and the final roll is due on 12 October 2026.
About 22.69 lakh electors were flagged for logical discrepancies, and about 22.41 lakh cases had been cleared by 22 September, as the press reported.
cannot_show: The exact number of electors on the draft roll was not published in anything found. The press gives about 1.93 or 1.94 crore, so the draft is left out.
No table by district or constituency was found from the Chief Electoral Officer. The district figures shown are the five largest, rounded, as the press printed them.
Exact counts for two of those districts were seen only in an excerpt of a social media post and are not used.
No split by sex of the roll or of the names left off was found.
No count of claims and objections, and no exact count of notices, was found.
The final roll had not been found when these figures were gathered.
